description: 24 Hours. 450+ Developers. One Mission. PROMPTOTHON 2026 is a 24-hour AI hackathon bringing together students, developers, innovators, creators, and AI enthusiasts to build impactful solutions using AI, LLMs, Machine Learning, and Automation . Open to everyone! Whether you're a beginner, experienced developer, student, professional, or simply passionate about technology — you can participate. Participants will collaborate in teams, tackle challenges, and turn their ideas into working prototypes within 24 hours. Domains LLMs & Automation AI/ML Open Innovation Team Size 2-4 members per team Event Details September 26–27, 2026 AVN Institute of Engineering & Technology, Hyderabad Registration Fee: ₹499 per participant Theme: Code the Storm. Build the Future. Ready to Build? Bring your ideas, form your team, and compete with 450+ developers and innovators in an intense 24-hour building experience. Join the Official WhatsApp Group: https://chat.whatsapp.com/KUMhAUHWiNMHdc4mNiRU0F?s=cl&p=a&mlu=4&ilr=4 Build. Innovate. Compete. Make an Impact.
organiser: AVN Institute of Engineering and Technology (AVN IET), Ramdaspally, Telangana
